description: Create SessionSummary mnemons (the memory of one played session): the story as the Markdown body, plus a short recap shown as "Previously on". Players may not call this — GM/co-GM only.

date.description: Only for a summary NOT linked to a calendar session (e.g. a past chapter brought into Argo): ISO date (2024-02-10) or date-time. A linked summary takes its date from the calendar; linking clears this. An empty string clears it.

markdown.description: The session's story as Markdown, with headed sections such as What happened, Decisions, Loot, Open threads, Combats and Where we left off. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>).

recap.description: Short recap, 1-3 sentences, ending on where the party stands. Shown as "Previously on" on the next session and the campaign Dashboard. The full story goes in the Markdown body.

sessionNumber.description: Only for a summary NOT linked to a calendar session: its chapter number, a positive whole number. A linked summary is numbered by the calendar; linking clears this. 0 clears it.

name: create_session_summary_mnemons
title: Create session summary mnemons
